# ASPEC Entity Contributor Agreement

**Version 1.0**

This Entity Contributor Agreement (the **Agreement**) is between the legal entity named when it is accepted (**You**) and **ASPEC RACING PTY LTD** (ABN 41 676 208 227), an Australian proprietary company (**ASPEC**, **We** or **Us**). It is accepted for You by the individual signatory identified by the GitHub account that accepts it (the **Signatory**).

It covers Contributions Submitted on Your behalf by Your Authorised Contributors to any project that ASPEC owns or manages and that refers to this Agreement (each a **Project**). Under this Agreement You assign the copyright in those Contributions to ASPEC, and ASPEC licenses them back to You.

## 1. Definitions

1.1 **Legal Entity** means a company, partnership, trust, government body or any other person who is not a natural person.

1.2 **Affiliate** means any Legal Entity that Controls You, is Controlled by You or is under common Control with You. **Control** means direct or indirect power to direct management and policies, whether by contract or otherwise, ownership of 50% or more of the voting securities, or beneficial ownership of the entity.

1.3 **Authorised Contributor** means an individual (usually an employee or contractor) whom You have authorised to Submit Contributions on Your behalf, and who is recorded by ASPEC as covered by this Agreement. The record is made under the list You give ASPEC, as updated by notice from You from time to time (Schedule 1).

1.4 **Contribution** means any original work of authorship Submitted to a Project by an Authorised Contributor on Your behalf, or in which You or Your Affiliates own or assert Copyright. It includes source code, documentation, designs, images and other material, and changes to existing material. Something marked clearly in writing as "Not a Contribution" at the time it is Submitted is excluded.

1.5 **Submit**, **Copyright**, **Effective Date**, **Existing Contribution** and **Submission Date** have the meanings given in the ASPEC Individual Contributor Agreement, version 1.0, applied to You and Your Authorised Contributors.

1.6 **Patent Claims** means any patent claims that You or Your Affiliates own or control now or later, and that would be infringed by making, using, selling or otherwise dealing in a Contribution, alone or combined with the Project it was Submitted to.

## 2. Assignment and licences

2.1 **Assignment.** You assign to ASPEC, and You procure that Your Affiliates assign to ASPEC, all right, title and interest in the Copyright in each Contribution, including each Existing Contribution. For Contributions not yet made, this is an assignment of future copyright for the purposes of section 197 of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth) and corresponding laws elsewhere. ASPEC accepts the assignment.

2.2 **Licence back.** ASPEC grants You and Your Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence under the Copyright in each Contribution to use, reproduce, modify, distribute and otherwise deal with that Contribution for any purpose, including commercial purposes. You may sublicense this licence, but You may not grant anyone an exclusive licence in a Contribution or assign this licence except to a successor to substantially all of Your relevant business. It gives You no rights in the rest of a Project.

2.3 **Fallback licence.** If the assignment in clause 2.1 is not effective for any Contribution, in any jurisdiction or for any reason, You grant ASPEC, and procure that Your Affiliates grant ASPEC, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, exclusive (except for the licence in clause 2.2 and any licence that applied to an Existing Contribution before the Effective Date), royalty-free and fee-free licence under the Copyright in that Contribution. ASPEC may transfer it and sublicense it through multiple tiers. It covers every act that the owner of the Copyright could do or authorise, in any form or medium. If the licence cannot be exclusive under the applicable law, it is non-exclusive.

2.4 **Outbound licensing.** ASPEC may license, sublicense or distribute any Contribution, and any work that includes it, under any terms ASPEC chooses. These include open-source, source-available, proprietary and commercial licences, with or without charge. However, if ASPEC includes a Contribution in any work that it makes available to third parties, ASPEC will also license the Contribution under the licence or licences that applied to the Project on the Submission Date, in addition to any other terms it chooses.

2.5 **Patent licence.** You grant ASPEC, and everyone who receives a Project or Contribution from ASPEC directly or indirectly, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence under the Patent Claims. It allows them to make, have made, use, sell, offer to sell, import and otherwise transfer the Contribution, and the Project combined with it. ASPEC may sublicense and transfer this licence.

2.6 **Moral rights.** You will obtain, from each individual author of a Contribution, that author's genuine written consent for the purposes of Part IX of the *Copyright Act 1968* (Cth) and corresponding laws elsewhere. The consent must be in the terms of clause 2.6 of the ASPEC Individual Contributor Agreement, version 1.0, and You must obtain it before the Contribution is Submitted.

2.7 **Limited waiver of claims.** You agree, and procure that Your Affiliates agree, not to make any claim against ASPEC, its licensees or its successors that arises from the exercise of the rights given to them by this Agreement in the Contributions. This waiver covers only the Contributions and the rights given under this Agreement. It does not affect any other claim, or Your rights under clause 2.2 or clause 2.4.

2.8 **Existing Contributions.** The assignment, licences and consents in this clause 2 apply to Existing Contributions and are irrevocable for them.

2.9 **No obligation; reserved rights.** ASPEC does not have to use any Contribution. You keep all rights not expressly assigned or granted.

## 3. Your confirmations

You confirm that:

(a) the Signatory is authorised to bind You, and You have the power to enter into this Agreement;

(b) You and Your Affiliates own, or otherwise have enough rights in, each Contribution to make the assignment and grant the licences in clause 2;

(c) neither You nor any Affiliate has granted, or will grant, rights in a Contribution that conflict with this Agreement;

(d) each Authorised Contributor is authorised by You to Submit Contributions on Your behalf, and You will notify ASPEC promptly in writing when an individual stops being an Authorised Contributor;

(e) any part of a Contribution that is not original to You, Your Affiliates or Your Authorised Contributors will be identified when it is Submitted, together with its source and any licence or other restrictions that apply.

## 4. General terms

Clauses 4 (Ending future contributions and removal), 5 (Disclaimer and liability) and 6 (General) of the ASPEC Individual Contributor Agreement, version 1.0, apply to this Agreement as if set out in full. References in them to "You" are references to the entity, and the Signatory's electronic acceptance is Your signature for the purposes of clause 6.1.

## 5. Verification

The Agreement takes effect when the Signatory accepts it. However, ASPEC will treat Contributions as covered by it only after ASPEC has verified the Signatory's authority and the list of Authorised Contributors to its reasonable satisfaction. ASPEC may ask for evidence, such as a signed copy of this Agreement on Your letterhead.
